Or, the win condition might be related to the bottom row: the U is at the bottom, and maybe the bar needs to be at the bottom row (row 44-47 or 52-55?) when pressing SPACE at the U center. Let me also reconsider: maybe the win condition is "press SPACE at the pin position exactly N times (N<5)"? For example, 3 times? I've pressed 5 times (died), and in run 6 I pressed... in run 6 I pressed 5 times (died). In previous runs, how many times did I press at the pin position? Total 10: run 5 = 5 (died), run 6 = 5 (died). So I've never pressed 1-4 times at the pin position and then stopped!
Hmm! What if the win condition is "press SPACE at the pin position exactly 3 times"? I've never tried stopping at 3.
But wait, in run 6 I pressed at the pin position at 145, 148, 151, 152 (4 times) and survived, then pressed a 5th time at 153 → died. So 4 times is safe. If the win condition is 3 times, I should have won at 151 (the 3rd press). I didn't. If the win condition is 4 times, I should have won at 152. I didn't. So the pin count is not the win condition (at least not 3 or 4).
Unless the win condition requires a specific row (e.g., the bar needs to be at row 12, which it was). Hmm, the bar was at row 12 in both run 5 and run 6. So no.
Therefore the pin is purely a trap (5 = death). The win condition must involve the U or something else.
Plan: 5 SPACE presses at LEFTU (row 16, column 12) → check; then 6 RIGHTs → 5 SPACE presses at RIGHTU (row 16, column 36) → check. If no win, think more.
Actually wait — should I press at row 16 or row 44? The U is at the bottom (rows 52-61). Row 44 is directly above the U. Row 16 is in the middle of the screen. If the mechanic is "press SPACE while aligned above the U," row 44 (directly above) might matter. But I've already pressed once each at (44, LEFTU) and (44, RIGHTU) with no effect.
Hmm, but maybe the count is per (row, column) position? (44, LEFTU) has 1 press, (16, LEFTU) has 0 presses. If the count is per exact position, I'd need 5 presses at the same exact position.
To be safe: pick one exact position and press 5 times. Which one? (44, LEFTU) already has 1 press → 4 more to reach 5. That saves 1 action!
Path: from (16,12) to (44,12): 7 DOWNs. Then 4 SPACE presses (total 5 at that position). Then to (44,36): 6 RIGHTs. Then 5 SPACE presses (total 5 at (44, RIGHTU), which already has 1 press... wait, (44, RIGHTU) has 1 press → 4 more).
Total: 7 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 21 actions. 11 remaining. OK.
But if the count is per column (not per exact position), then (44, LEFTU) + (16, LEFTU) = 2 presses at the LEFTU column; 3 more needed. Ugh, ambiguous.
Simplest and most robust approach: press 5 times at one exact position (44,12) → total 6 at that position (1 previous + 5 new). If the win condition is "5 at a position," it triggers on the 5th new press (total 6). If the win condition is "5 at a column," it triggers earlier. Either way, 5 new presses at (44,12) covers "5 at a position" (reached at new press 5) — no wait: if the count is per position, then after 5 new presses, (44,12) has 6 total; the 5th total was reached on new press 4. Either way, it triggers within 5 new presses. ✓
And if LEFTU is also a trap (5 = death), I die on new press 4. Risk accepted.
